title: 时间短语和动作顺序
context: 说话者说明昨天先完成什么，再出门。

segments.text: 昨天我先吃饭，然后去上课。
segments.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ xiān chīfàn, ránhòu qù shàngkè.
segments.translation: Yesterday I ate first, then went to class.

task: Put the time phrase and two actions in a natural order.
revision_prompt: Make the sequence between the two actions explicit.
transfer_prompt: Describe two things you did this morning in order.
